snippet.title: ALATURKA - Gameplay Teaser | INDIE Live Expo 2026
snippet.description:
If you want to experience heavy PS2-era driving physics and retro open-world action, please support my childhood dream by adding ALATURKA to your Steam Wishlist!
👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4226560?utm_source=bufuakgames&utm_medium=youtube&utm_campaign=indieliveexpo&utm_content=gameplayteaser

I am incredibly proud to reveal the early gameplay teaser for ALATURKA, celebrating my official selection for the INDIE Live Expo 2026 (INDIE Waves segment)!

About ALATURKA:
ALATURKA is a physics-heavy open-world crime sim set in the fictionalized underground of 1970s Turkey. It intentionally rejects modern, weightless arcade driving, instead featuring deeply simulated vehicle suspension physics that capture the raw, chaotic experience of early 2000s action games.

Developed entirely solo, live on stream, using 100% Unreal Engine Blueprints (Zero C++).

Join the Family & Watch the Live Development:
👾 Discord: https://discord.gg/tbSEDnftPA
🐦 Twitter/X: x.com/bufuakgames

INDIE Live Expo 2026:
Catch ALATURKA in the INDIE Waves segment on April 25, 2026!
📺 Official Stream / 配信リンク: https://www.youtube.com/live/oymRC7dHz5o
